facts.quote: Within each prompt-optimization experiment, the same model performs task solving, reflection, and prompt revision, with its parameters fixed; Qwen’s thinking mode is disabled. Final task inference uses temperature 0.7 0.7 , as do reflection and revision. Task responses have a maximum output budget of 4,096 tokens. For every method, final test scores are averaged over three inference seeds.
